project.title: dxtr_card_scan
project.tagline: A configurable Flutter camera and preprocessing package for document scanning.

summary.short: dxtr_card_scan provides a configurable camera/gallery capture flow for document scanning with orientation-aware framing, theming, flash/torch controls, zoom, and Rust-backed post-processing.
summary.long: The package is being calibrated for real devices and supports portrait/landscape constraints, frame alignment and padding, customizable capture controls, gallery input, edge detection, deskew, optional black-and-white conversion, and resize processing.

highlights: Flash, torch, zoom, and gallery flows
